thesis: Algorithms predict chosen labels and shape exposure; abundant attractive forms do not settle value, authorship or machine experience.

ideas.statement: Prediction accuracy does not validate a criterion; recommendation can expand or narrow developing taste, while attention and relationships remain scarce.

evidenceAndExamples.statement: Identical generated images received different ratings by authorship label; provenance can be relevant to a work as an act, and abundance scenarios are not market forecasts.

objectionsAndQualifications.statement: Identical generated images received different ratings by authorship label; provenance can be relevant to a work as an act, and abundance scenarios are not market forecasts.

audit.notes: Direct active-LLM analysis; argument distinguished from established empirical result.
